tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
§ Rimmon = "pomegranate"
n pr dei
the deity of wind, rain, and storm, worshipped by the Syrians of Damascus

A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.4.2;
father of: Baanah (H1196), Rechab (H7394)
§ Rimmon = "pomegranate"
a Benjamite of Beeroth, the father of Rechab and Baanah, the murderers of Ishbosheth

Rimmon = "pomegranate"
a Levitical city in Zebulun located approximately 6 miles north of Nazareth
Another name of dim.nah (דִּמְנָה "Dimnah" H1829)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shorter) (רִמֹּן; or רִמּוֹנוֹ; (1 Chronicles 6:62 (H77 (אֶבֶץ))), the same as H7416 (רִמּוֹן); in Joshua 19:13: הַמְּתֹאָר is mistaken for part of a name; article with the passive participle of H8388 (תָּאַר); the (one) marked off, i.e. which pertains).
